notes.title: 《Three Kingdoms Mushouden》 – Future Update Plan Report!
notes.content:
Generals, it’s been a while!

It’s been nearly two weeks since the launch of the Creative Workshop, and during this time, more and more players have joined the world of 《Three Kingdoms Mushouden》 to experience this journey with us. Thank you so much for your attention and support!

We’ve also received many “When’s the next update?” messages recently. First of all, thank you for caring, and secondly, let us say this clearly: [b]We’re not running away![/b]
As the game has gradually become more stable, we’ve decided to go into “closed-door development” for a while, focusing our energy on [b]deeper gameplay design and new feature development.[/b]

During this period, regular version updates may not be as frequent as before, but we will continue [b]expanding the functionality of the Creative Workshop[/b] and polishing the game by fixing issues that may affect your experience. We also encourage everyone to keep creating and sharing great ideas with us!
Here’s what’s planned for the future:

[h3][b]New Features for the Creative Workshop:[/b][/h3]

Since the Workshop went live, we’ve already seen many amazing mods created by players. Thank you so much for your creativity!

At the same time, we’ve gathered plenty of feedback from the community. Moving forward, we’ll gradually unlock more editors to give you greater freedom in building your own Three Kingdoms world:
[list]
[*] Quest Editor
[*] Story Editor
[*] Skill Editor
[*] Clan & Bandit Camp Editor
[/list]
Through these tools, we hope you’ll unleash your creativity and imagination in the world of 《Three Kingdoms Mushouden》. Please make full use of them!

[h3][b]In addition, here are the contents already scheduled to be released in the near future:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The Challenge Campaign of Zuo Ci’s Phantom Array (including red gear)
[*] Awakening Chronicles of Guan Yu and Zhang Liao
[/list]
These will officially meet you in upcoming updates! If you have any thoughts or suggestions about them, please feel free to share them with us on Discord!

Since the game’s release, we’ve also received a huge amount of feedback and suggestions through the community and private messages. These have provided us with direction and encouragement!

In particular, regarding gameplay expansion suggestions such as [b]“Conquering Cities and Lands”[/b] and [b]“Founding Your Own Clan”[/b], we’ve taken note of them! Once the above major content is steadily implemented, we’ll look for the right timing to introduce these features. As for other community feedback, we will also take it seriously and continue to consider improvements. Please keep holding us accountable!

[h3][b]BUG Reports & Feedback[/b][/h3]
If you have interesting ideas or suggestions beyond the topics above, please don’t hesitate to share them on Discord. We’ll continue to pay close attention!

notes.title: The Workshop for Three Kingdoms Mushouden is Now Officially Live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and thanks for your patience!

[h3][b]The long-awaited [b]Three Kingdoms Mushouden Workshop[/b] is finally here![/b][/h3]

At the same time, as we previewed last week, the [b]imaginary general Zhen Ji[/b] has also officially joined the roster. Feel free to check her out in-game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280285/0be2826fa6c7f5af389c004b5f7e8a5bab38a14d.png[/img]

[h3][b]🎨 About the Workshop[/b][/h3]

First of all, thank you for your support and patience! The long-awaited [b]Workshop[/b] feature is finally here!

As a strategy game, we’ve always hoped that Three Kingdoms Mushouden can grow with the community and stay vibrant for a long time. That’s why we warmly invite all players who love the Three Kingdoms to use our tools to help make the world of Mushouden more complete, more diverse, and more fun!

This is currently [b]Workshop version 0.1[/b], so there may still be some rough edges in mod syncing or usability. We'll [b]keep monitoring your feedback closely and continue updating[/b] to make modding and using mods more free and seamless. Please feel free to share your thoughts with us!

We’ve also prepared a brief user guide for you. You can find it in the game menu by navigating to:
[Creative Workshop] → [Create Mod] → [New Project] → [Edit Project] → [Tutorial & Template].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280285/9480349f51e46862f0bdcefb4a54918083760448.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280285/d2e2644696a34740317cd72e778cf9f37f01536f.png[/img]

To maintain a healthy community environment, we strongly discourage the creation of mods containing the following content. We may [b]remove such Workshop content without prior notice[/b] if we believe it violates our guidelines.

[b]Prohibited content includes but is not limited to:[/b]
[list]
[*] Content that violates laws in the dev team’s or Steam platform's regions, including political topics and child exploitation;
[*] Use of unauthorized or copyright-infringing materials;
[*] Mods created using AI-generated content;
[*] Any [b]off-site links[/b], paid content, or any form of monetization through mods.
[/list]
[h3][b]Other new features in this update:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Zhen Ji is now available[/b] and can be triggered and recruited in-game;
[*] A new [b]Red Armor[/b] drops at low chance from high-level bandit camps;
[*] A new [b]Red Helmet[/b] also drops at low chance from high-level bandit camps.
[/list]
If you encounter any further issues while playing, feel free to contact us on Discord. We’ll keep listening. Thank you again for your valuable feedback and support!

notes.title: Steam Workshop Update Delay – Our Sincere Apologies!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is the dev team still battling bugs in the Steam Workshop system.

We’re very sorry to inform you that the [b]Steam Workshop feature originally scheduled for this week has been postponed to next week[/b]. We're still working on adjustments and testing.

In the latest test version, the Workshop didn’t perform as expected. We discovered some serious issues, especially bugs related to [b]Steam mod synchronization[/b] and overall usability. Releasing it in its current state could result in a very poor user experience—something we definitely do not want!

Therefore, [b]we’ve decided to delay the launch[/b] and will only release it once the feature has been thoroughly tested and is stable.

[h3][b]A heartfelt thank-you to all the players who’ve been following and supporting us![/b][/h3]

To show our gratitude and apologies, we’ll be adding a new Imaginary Hero – Zhen Ji in an upcoming update.

Thank you again for your continued support. We’ll keep working hard to make the game better!

Having support staff review your case often leads to a quicker resolution.

Steam top-left menu → [Help] → [Steam Support] → Steam Client → Client Crashes → Contact Steam Support

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280285/468829285a8f40393e2909f5e8033a81563f1280.jpg[/img]

[list]

[*] Corrected various errors in the Japanese translation.
[*] Fixed floating tooltip bug when skill level is 0.
[*] Fixed bug where Zhang Xiu, Cao Chun, and Yue Jin’s awakening quests could get stuck.
[*] Resolved issues with visible but inaccessible ancient tombs.
[*] Fixed freezing issues when entering certain cities.
[*] Fixed bug where unawakened characters showed “weapon mismatch” messages. It now works correctly.
[*] Fixed unresponsive left/right movement keys during convoy missions.
[*] Corrected several typos.
[*] Fixed visual overlap issues in missing person quests.
[*] Fixed incorrect max stamina cap for custom officers.
[/list]
[b][Optimizations][/b]
[list]
[*] Added equipment comparison feature.
[*] In 1v1 Duel Mode, characters will no longer die.
[*] Added difficulty descriptions to help players choose the right challenge level.
[*] Slightly increased the ultimate skill damage of Wen Pin and Cao Chun.
[*] Fixed bug where officers recruited using the “Talent Scout” skill still appear at inns.
[*] Removed rejection options from some historical officer quests.
[/list]
[h2][b]🔧 Short-Term Update Plan[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] In the near future, we’ll be releasing the following features and content:
[*] New officers and portraits.
[*] Ultimate skill learning system.
[*] Military advisor skill learning system.
[*] Full officer list and equipment comparison system.
[*] Note: Equipment comparison was added in ver1.14 – feel free to try it out!
[*] “Non-human” challenge mode.
[*] New customizable hotkeys.
[*] Ability to regroup mountain bandits after dispersal.
[*] Post-ending world updates, including new bandits, hideouts, and rewards.
[/list]
[h2][b]🚀 Major Update Roadmap[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Here are the major updates many of you have asked about, already in planning:
[*] Full support for the Steam Workshop – everyone is welcome to create and share content.
[*] Our first free DLC, titled "The Legend of Zhao Yun", is in development!
[/list]
[h2][b]📘 New Player Tips – A Letter from the Dev Team[/b][/h2]
We’ve prepared a New Player Guide to help you get started with the gameplay mechanics and enjoy the strategic depth of the game!

[u][b]1. Survival first. Choose your battles wisely.[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Not all higher-star quests are better.
[*] Evaluate your party’s strength and choose quests accordingly.
[*] Attempting high-difficulty missions too early may result in injuries, broken gear, or an unrecoverable spiral toward defeat.
[/list]
[u][b]2. [Gear and Weapon Choice][/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Always equip characters with appropriate weapons for their troop type (short/long weapons) to ensure accuracy.
[*] Pay attention to stamina: if it’s [below 50], avoid equipping heavy gear.
[*] Pro Tip: Stick to one weapon early on. Once you're familiar with the system, consider dual-wielding.
[/list]
[u][b]3. Join a Noble Clan[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] After reaching Prestige Level 3. quickly join a noble clan for access to powerful units and supplies.
[*] You can also rent elite officers before you earn enough merit.
[/list]
[b][u]4. On Trading & Tomb Raiding[/u][/b]
We don’t recommend relying solely on these as your main income sources.
[list]
[*] These were fallback mechanics during past testing phases.
[*] In the full game, they are supplementary and situational – do them if they're along your route or fill a gap in your strategy.
[*] Example: If you're aiming to recruit Zhang Fei, align with the Lu Clan in Zhuo Commandery and complete clan quests. While doing this, feel free to trade or explore any nearby tombs.
[/list]
[u][b]5. Clan Quest Tips[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Early on, focus on “Procurement” and “Diplomacy” type missions.
[*] You can change quest types via the [“Consult”] function and refresh available tasks.
[/list]
[u][b]6. Historical Officer Recommendations[/b][/u]

[list]

[*] Cao Chun and Cao Ren – Qiao Commandery
[*] Ju Shou – Julu (strong military strategist)

Many more elite officers await your discovery!

[u][b]8. Additional Tips[/b][/u]

[*] Download the full map guide to better understand terrain and progression routes.
[*] Bandit camps can be [visited or hired as mercenaries] – but they’re expensive!
[*] Battle missions offer high rewards – aim for high scores!
[*] Once you’re powerful enough, [wipe out bandit hideouts] for big gains!
[/list]
[h2][b]🆕 What’s New in the Full Version Compared to the Demo?[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Just in case you missed it, here’s what the full release adds over the demo:
[*] Main storyline extended to 35 chapters with over 100,000 new words.
[*] 30+ new officer ultimates.
[*] 20+ new historical officers.
[*] 20+ new active strategist skills and 20+ overseer skills.

[*] Equipment system now includes 4 higher-quality tiers.
[*] Over 300,000 new words of dialogue, enriching the world and characters.
[/list]
Thank you once again for your interest and support for Three Kingdoms: Mushouden!
We will continue listening to the voices of our community and working hard to fix issues and improve the gameplay experience.

If you encounter any bugs or problems during your playthrough, please don’t hesitate to let us know on Discord — we take every report seriously and will carefully review them!

notes.title: Update Log – June 17, 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
We've just released a new installation package that primarily addresses issues affecting the gameplay experience — such as the disappearance of tomb exploration options. The current version of the game is ver1.12. You can verify whether you’ve updated to the latest version from the top-left corner of the in-game screen.

[Fixes & Improvements]

Fixed a bug where Wen Pin would not appear in the wild if his quest failed.

Fixed an issue where battle music would incorrectly play after story sound effects.

Fixed a bug where options would disappear after clicking "Leave" in tomb exploration or selecting the strategist’s suggestion.

Fixed shortcut keys becoming unresponsive during the initial cutscene.

Fixed missing resources in the battle tutorial.

Adjusted enemy detection logic in certain battles.

Corrected several text errors.

Adjusted the trigger condition for Zhang Xun’s quest: now requires Reputation Level 4 (previously Level 2).

[Download Issues Notice]

We’ve also noticed that some players are experiencing freezing issues during downloads.

Following an urgent investigation by our technical team, we’ve preliminarily determined that this issue is related to network node fluctuations on the Steam client side and not caused by the game itself (we are currently unable to reproduce the bug in local testing). We’ve contacted Steam support for assistance, but have not yet received a clear response.

To ensure your download and gameplay experience, we recommend trying the following solutions:

1. Change your download region
Steam → Settings → Downloads → Download Region → Select a less congested region (e.g., “East Africa”) → Restart Steam and retry the download.
You can switch back to your original region after completing the download.

2. Exit Steam and use a network accelerator (VPN)
3. Pause the download on the Steam download screen, wait a few seconds, and resume — this may bypass the stuck point.
4. Manually set your DNS to a more stable server, such as Google’s 8.8.8.8 or Cloudflare’s 1.1.1.1 — this may improve download speed.
5. Temporarily disable Windows Firewall and ensure you have sufficient disk space for installation.

Thank you for playing!
If you encounter any issues during gameplay, please reach out to us via our Discord server — we’re actively monitoring and here to help!

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 1.27 and Earlier (Partial)
notes.content:
Since we have no experience, we didn’t write update logs before, but we will keep track of them from now on.
Here are some key updates from earlier versions:

The game now automatically calls the language settings based on your operating system language.
The success rate for noble clan advice has been greatly improved.
Fixed the issue with the incorrect tomb level when advisors search for ancient tombs.
Fixed some attributes of horses in combat and made them effective.
Talent attributes are now correctly displayed in the character stat panel.
Items now display their concealment value.
You can now select the tomb level in the exploration feature.
After reaching a sufficient level of favorability, recruiting officers is no longer based on random probability, it is now guaranteed to succeed.
Fixed the issue with the cart movement speed.
The cart now allows for additional backpack slots.
Fixed the bug where hired generals would not return to their original family after the contract expires.
Optimized battle performance.
Fixed the issue where advisors would report incorrect event details.
Added 32 new battle portraits for generals (previously, they used generic portraits).
Fixed the issue where monsters would not move after quickly pausing and resuming the game multiple times.
Fixed the issue where monsters would move while the game was paused during save/load.
Fixed the issue where saving the game with the same name would cause errors.
Fixed the issue where task failure would not display after retrying the task.
Fixed the issue where closing the game while nobles gave free equipment would cause the game to freeze.
Fixed the issue where the nobles' dialogues were not properly shielded, causing the game to freeze.
Fixed the issue where quickly clicking "Leave" during the duel after visiting a general would cause the game to freeze.
Fixed the issue where spy missions would occasionally fail to select the right person.
Fixed the issue where the task reminder for generals' dungeon quests was missing.
Added a new beginner's quest "Sima Yan's Horse Gift" in new saves, which cannot be triggered in Inferno difficulty.
Adjusted the difficulty of quests available early on; players with Level 2 reputation previously couldn’t accept high-level quests, except for Inferno difficulty.
Fixed the bug where the player couldn’t deliver heads to the authorities.
Added an in-game help feature.
The excavation adventure button is now easier to click (previously it would sometimes not respond after multiple attempts).
Adjusted the number of followers you can bring at the beginning of the game.
Adjusted the stats of some high-level equipment.
Fixed the issue with the white frame around the character icons in the team.
Fixed the issue with self-allocated skill points when recruiting people at outdoor buildings.
Fixed some talent-related issues (all talents have been tested).
Fixed multiple bugs where players would get stuck in mountains.
Fixed the issue where some reconnaissance missions would lead to unmovable areas.
